product.title: Highlights of Aspen Tour

description.text: Discover Aspen's charm on this engaging one-hour walking tour, perfect for first-time visitors or those short on time. Explore iconic landmarks like the Wheeler Opera House, Aspen Art Museum, and Wagner Park while learning about the town's rich history, culture, and vibrant community. Stops include Wheeler Opera House, Aspen Art Museum, Aspen Mountain / Ajax, Mill Street Fountain, Wagner Park. With a relaxed pace and insightful commentary, this tour offers a delightful snapshot of Aspen's unique character. Ideal for visitors basing in Aspen who want a guided mountain-town experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
